title: Sermon on the Mount: True Devotion and Trust in God

questions.question: What is the general principle Jesus gives regarding practicing your righteousness (giving, praying, fasting)?
options: Do not practice your righteousness before other people in order to be seen by them
Do it publicly so others may be inspired by it
Do it only in the temple courts
Do it only once a year on the day of atonement
questions.correctAnswer: Do not practice your righteousness before other people in order to be seen by them
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:1 (ESV): "Beware of practicing your righteousness before other people in order to be seen by them, for then you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven."

questions.question: When you give to the needy, what should you not do?
options: Sound no trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets
Give them food instead of money
questions.correctAnswer: Sound no trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:2 (ESV): "Thus, when you give to the needy, sound no trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may be praised by others..."

questions.question: How secretly should you give to the needy?
options: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing
Post it on notice boards anonymously
questions.correctAnswer: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:3 (ESV): "But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,"

questions.question: When you pray, Jesus says to go where?
options: Go into your room and shut the door
questions.correctAnswer: Go into your room and shut the door
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:6 (ESV): "But when you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret..."

questions.question: What do the Gentiles do in prayer that Jesus tells His disciples not to emulate?
options: They heap up empty phrases, thinking they will be heard for their many words
They pray to statues of Roman gods
They sing their prayers instead of speaking
questions.correctAnswer: They heap up empty phrases, thinking they will be heard for their many words
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:7 (ESV): "And when you pray, do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard for their many words."

questions.question: In the Lord's Prayer, what follows "Our Father in heaven"?
options: "give us this day our daily bread."
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:9 (ESV): "Pray then like this: 'Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.'"

questions.question: What condition does Jesus add to God forgiving our trespasses?
options: "For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you,"
"If you sacrifice a lamb without blemish,"
"If you recite this prayer three times,"
questions.correctAnswer: "For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you,"
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:14 (ESV): "For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you,"

questions.question: How do the hypocrites act when they fast, to be seen by others?
options: They look gloomy and disfigure their faces that their fasting may be seen by others
They sound trumpets in the streets announcing their fast
They wear sackcloth and pour ashes on their heads publicly
questions.correctAnswer: They look gloomy and disfigure their faces that their fasting may be seen by others
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:16 (ESV): "And when you fast, do not look gloomy like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces that their fasting may be seen by others..."

questions.question: Where does Jesus tell His followers to lay up treasures?
options: In heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal
In the temple treasury in Jerusalem
In jars of clay buried in the field
In good deeds recorded by the scribes
questions.correctAnswer: In heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:20 (ESV): "but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal."

questions.question: Jesus teaches: "For where your treasure is, there your ______ will be also."
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:21 (ESV): "For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also."

questions.question: What is the "lamp of the body"?
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:22 (ESV): "The eye is the lamp of the body. So, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light,"

questions.question: Who are the two masters that Jesus says no one can serve?
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:24 (ESV): "No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve God and money." (In older translations "Mammon").

questions.question: What birds does Jesus use as an example to show that God provides without them sowing or reaping?
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:26 (ESV): "Look at the birds of the air: they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?"

questions.question: What flower does Jesus use to show that God clothes even the grass better than Solomon in all his glory?
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:28-29 (ESV): "Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin, yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these."

questions.question: Complete the verse: "But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness..."
options: and all these things will be added to you
and you shall inherit the earth
and the angels will minister to you
and poverty will never touch you
questions.correctAnswer: and all these things will be added to you
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:33 (ESV): "But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you."

key_verse_text: "But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you."
